items.content: the production database is PostgreSQL 16 with the VectorChord extension
our continuous integration runs on GitHub Actions using the mise toolchain
the staging environment is deployed to the Talos kubernetes cluster
API authentication uses bearer tokens stored in the vault
the frontend is built with React and served via nginx
logs are shipped to VictoriaLogs and dashboards live in Grafana
the embeddings model is bge-m3 with 1024 dimensions
nightly backups are written to the MinIO object store
the daily team standup happens at 9am every weekday
rate limiting is enforced at 100 requests per minute per token
